items.text: IMPORTANT: This checklist is not an authoritative document. Full reference must be made to the individual aircraft flight Manual/Pilot Operating handbook as amended. Current ANO and AICs and Pilot Order book/Flying School Syllabus, local procedures, may also be relevant.
Documentation complete and satisfactory, including valid Certificate of Maintenance if required.
WEATHER: Local, en-route and destination forecasts and actuals.
FLIGHT PLANNING: Current AIP/Flight Guide, NOTAMS, Amendments and bulletins. PPR, Daylight remaining, etc.
FUEL: Sufficient to destination and alternates, Contingency.
CHARTS: Current and sufficient coverage for flight.
WEIGHT & BALANCE: Load (passengers, baggage, fuel) within limits.
PERFORMANCE: Take-off, en-route and range, landing.
PASSENGERS: Comfort and safety briefing, emergency procedures.
PILOT: Licence and experience current and valid. Medical certificate valid, fitness for flight.
SURVIVAL EQUIPMENT: For over water flight - dinghy accessible, Lifejackets worn but not inflated, Flares, Transceiver, ELT.
BOOK-OUT: Departure ATC, airfield movements book, aircraft tech. log.
FLIGHT PLAN: File for IFR and International Flights, flight across water and sparsely populated areas.

sections.title: PRE-FLIGHT ACTION OF PILOT IN COMMAND - APPROACHING AIRCRAFT

items.text: Check access to taxiways, obstructions, level surface.
Remove ANY ice or frost from ALL aircraft surfaces.

items.response: CONDITION, SECURITY, NAVIGATION AND STROBE LIGHTS

items.text: Leading Edge: dents, stall warner, pitot tube checked.

items.response: VISUALLY CHECK CONTENTS, CAP SECURE, FUEL DRAIN, VENT CLEAR

items.text: Tyre: condition, inflation, creep marks aligned.

items.response: OPEN, CHECK BAFFLES SECURE UNDAMAGED, THEN CLOSE COWL

items.text: Nose Leg & fairing: undamaged, tire properly inflated, mud scraper clear.
Tyre: condition, inflation, creep marks aligned.

items.response: VISUALLY CHECK CONTENTS, CAP SECURE, FUEL DRAIN, VENT CLEAR

items.text: Leading Edge: condition, check for dents.

items.response: CONDITION, SECURITY, NAVIGATION AND STROBE LIGHTS

items.text: Stall warning vane: lift, check if warning horn sounds.
Instruments: legible, serviceable, readings within limit.
Controls: full and free movement, correct sense.

FULL AND FREE MOVEMENT, SET COLD

items.text: Primer: prime as required and lock.
Oil Pressure: rising to green arc within 30 secs.
Radios: tuned and checked as required, taxi clearance.
Instruments: check in turns DI, Compass Turn Co-ordinator, Attitude indicat.
Position: into wind, clear all around.
Oil Temp. and Press: within limits.

items.response: SET HOT, MAX. DROP 100 RPM, SET COLD
CHECK LEFT & RIGHT, MAX DROP 175 RPM, DIFF. 50 RPM

items.text: Oil temp. and Press: within limits.

ON TANK WITH HIGHEST CONTENTS, FUEL PUMP ON

items.text: I - Instruments: checked and set, directional gyro altimeter, engine T° & pressure.
H - Hatches: doors and windows secure.
LOOKOUT: runway, approach and departure paths visually checked, ATC clearance.
Engine: Temp / Press, steady within limit.
Elevator Control: raise nose at 58 Mph – 50 Kts.
Climb speed: Best angle: 80 Mph (78 Mph – 68 Kts). Best rate: 90 Mph (91 Mph – 79 Kts). Normal: 100 Mph (98 Mph – 85 Kts).
Engine: Temp / Press, steady within limit.
Radios: set, ATC clearance as necessary.

sections.title: CRUISE / RE-JOIN CHECKS (F R E D A)

items.text: F - Fuel: "ON" and sufficient, pump "ON" if necessary, tanks even.
R - Radio: "ON" and correct frequency set, joining instructions if required.
E - Engine: Temp / Press, mixture, check for carb. ice.
A - Altimeter: QNH set as required.

items.response: ON FULLEST TANK, SUFFICIENT, FUEL PUMP ON

items.text: I - Instruments: engine temp & press checked, altimeter set.
Speed: Clean: 80 Mph - Flaps DN: 75 Mph. Full flaps landing = 70 Mph.
Flaps: retract in stages at safe height.
Position: into wind, nose wheel straight.

sections.title: PRE STALL / AEROBATIC CHECKS (H A S E L L)

items.text: H - Height: sufficient to recover by 3000' AGL (if spinning see POH).
A - Airframe: gyros caged, brakes off, flaps as required (see POH).
S - Security: hatches and harnesses tight and secure, no loose articles.
E - Engine: Temp / Press, check for carb ice, mixture RICH, fuel pump on.
L - Location: clear of cloud, controlled airspace, built up areas and airfields.
L - LOOKOUT: 360° turn to check for aircraft, especially below.

sections.title: CONTINUED STALL / AEROBATICS (H E L L)

items.text: Fuel: lb, G US, Lts, Kg, Time table transcribed approximately; refer to original document.
MTOW: ≤ 999 Kg (2200 lbs). BEW: 654 Kg (1442 lbs). Fret: ≤ 54 Kg (120 lbs). Fuel + Pax & Pilots: ≤ 415 Kg (± 4 POB & 150 Lts (40 G US)).

Emergency: 75 Mph 65 Kts. Vx = Best Angle: 80 Mph (78 (81) 68 Kts. Best glide: 83 Mph 72 Kts (with windmilling propeller). Vy = Best Rate: 90 Mph (91(85) 79 Kts. Vb: 119 Mph 103 Kts (Turbulent Air penetration speed). Va = manoeuvring 121 Mph 105 Kts. App speed: Flaps Up 80 Mph 70 Kts, Flaps DN 75 Mph 65 Kts. Landing: 70 Mph 61 Kts. Crosswind: 16 Kts.

sections.title: FIRE ON THE GROUND
sections.condition: If taxiing, stop clear of other aircraft, fuel trucks/stations, etc.

items.text: Evacuate to a safe distance upwind, taking fire extinguisher.
Forced landing procedure or diversion as applicable.
Radio: check freq, volume, squelch, check avionics selector/switches.
Headset: check plugs secure, change headsets, try hand microphone.
Electrics: check ammeter, master switch, circuit breakers – reset once only.
Speechless / Transmit blind / Non-radio procedure as appropriate.
If NO OUTPUT: Reset Master Switch
IF OUTPUT RESTORED: Restore essential electrics singly
IN THE EVENT OF REPEATED/CONTINUED ELECTRICAL failure: select only essential electrical services, divert if applicable. Note: radio transmission makes a particularly heavy drain on the battery.
Immediate actions: Lower nose to maintain emergency airspeed. Select landing area ahead - use flap as necessary.
Brief passengers/tighten harness/unlatch door as time permits.

sections.title: ENGINE FAILURE AT ALTITUDE (Forced landing without power)

items.text: Immediate actions: Attain and maintain best glide speed – TRIM. Assess surface wind - select suitable landing area. Plan approach pattern - check for cause of failure.
Fuel: change tanks, check sufficient, fuel pump on.
If engine does not restart, R/T MAYDAY call, Committed checks.
Crew / passengers: briefed, as time permits.

sections.title: DITCHING AT SEA - DITCHING PROCEDURE (without power)
sections.condition: Establish glide, head for coast line or any shipping area, check for causes of failure as time permits.

items.text: Large swell / Light wind: land along swell, tail down stalled. Light swell / Strong wind: landing into wind, tail down stalled.
DO NOT INFLATE LIFE JACKETS IN CABIN.
Emergencies by their nature are not standard, and this checklist can only provide a guide to the appropriate actions - in an emergency: PILOT JUDGEMENT SHOULD DICTATE PILOT ACTIONS.
